owner: Angelea McCullough, Founder of RMS Global Publishing
purpose: Connect independent creator and engagement communities into approved Reset programming while preserving each leader's identity, audience ownership and platform boundaries.

pilot.expansion_policy: Additional Discord rooms may receive automated sparks only when the room has an approved purpose, verified channel binding, moderation owner and activity template. No blanket cross-posting.

engagement_engine.goal: Seed useful activity inside Reset rooms so members have meaningful reasons to return, collaborate and participate.
prohibited_automation: automated likes or comments on behalf of members

spark_cadence.event_day_exception: approved event reminders may exceed routine cadence when directly tied to the event schedule

solo: Creator check-in: share one concrete move you are making today
Platform mission: complete one monetization-aligned task and report the result
Portfolio spark: share one current work-in-progress for constructive feedback
Discovery spark: introduce one skill, offer or collaboration need
group: Creator support circle with defined prompt
Clip or content challenge tied to platform-native monetization rules
Co-creation sprint with clear start, finish and recap

room_binding_contract.activation_rule: Do not activate automated sparks for a room until all required fields are verified.
room_binding_contract.fallback: If an automation dependency fails, the room remains usable and routine automation pauses rather than flooding or blocking the community.

revenue_lanes.name: Approved partner spotlights and promotional features
